definitions.ratio: Household-weighted mean of native modeled J/S at the same dwelling and date, percent
definitions.support: At least 100 households and 10 complexes; no complex exceeds 20% of represented households
definitions.intervals: Uncalibrated native envelopes; outward rounded to 0.1 percentage point
definitions.history: Current measured stock at historical endpoints; normal membership can change
definitions.unavailable: Insufficient support or withheld direct contrast; not a zero value
